title: The AI Infrastructure Control Layer
lede: Fonderie is the standard your AI reads. It defines, verifies, and locks every critical system — logins, payments, teams, permissions — so any assistant builds the same way every time. One playbook. Any AI. Zero improvisation.

steps.title: Describe your product
steps.text: I need logins, Stripe payments, and team workspaces.

steps.title: Fonderie defines the architecture
steps.text: Fonderie defines which systems to build and how they connect. Switch assistants anytime — the specification stays the same.

steps.title: Fonderie verifies the output
steps.text: Types, tests, and security checks run automatically. Every build is validated before it ships.

steps.title: Review and deploy
steps.text: You own the code. Customize the design, add your logic, deploy. Your code is secure, your screens work, and customers can sign up and pay.
